title: Independent Second-Line Review of TCD-017 Class-A Admission Readiness
result_scope: Independent second-line readiness review only. This is not B3 admission.

independent_checks.name: source_destination_ownership
independent_checks.finding: Hash-bound PREP01/PREP02 source audits and PREP06 ledger/state inventory consistently identify Addiorpotoppl as the top-reservoir DOP loss and Addiorpopl as redistributed layer DOP change.

independent_checks.name: exact_bapo_omission
independent_checks.finding: Source-bound PREP01/PREP02 audits identify Bapo(Redi,Ly) as containing Addiorpopl(I,Ln)*Z while omitting Addiorpotoppl(I)*Z; analogous ledgers include corresponding top terms.

independent_checks.name: natural_lwkm_activation
independent_checks.finding: Natural LWKM evidence activates the top-reservoir path with nonzero top loss -0.15380316471773922 kg/ha P and matching layer gain +0.15380316471773947 kg/ha P.

independent_checks.name: physical_control_volume_closure
independent_checks.finding: Before any reporting correction, natural LWKM top plus layer redistribution closes to about 2.5e-16 kg/ha P; SYNQ-O002 independently encodes the same closed internal-transfer identity.

independent_checks.name: candidate_write_set_reporting_only
independent_checks.finding: The candidate changes only Bapo(Redi,Ly) in Outbal_calc reporting accumulation and does not alter Addit or physical process routines.

independent_checks.name: physical_state_trajectory_noninterference
independent_checks.finding: Outbal_calc is after the timestep physical-process chain; diagnostic comparison reports unchanged state trajectories and no normalized ordinary non-balance output changes for the bounded candidate.

independent_checks.name: process_flux_trajectory_noninterference
independent_checks.finding: No process-flux write is introduced; the candidate is a Bapo reporting accumulation after process calculation, and bounded diagnostic comparisons report no process/ordinary-output trajectory changes.

independent_checks.name: expected_difference_whitelist_complete
independent_checks.finding: Observed bounded top-term differences are confined to Bapo and derived organic-P balance/report surfaces; all physical states, process fluxes, Bafop and non-whitelisted outputs remain forbidden.

independent_checks.name: other_organic_p_changes_excluded
independent_checks.finding: TCD-027 Bafop detailed-accumulator correction, TCD-028 stable-DOM event-accumulator lifecycle, AdStdiorpopl, Adhuexpopl, Bafop and all other organic-P changes are separate and excluded.

independent_checks.name: synq_o002_role
independent_checks.finding: SYNQ-O002 is used only as independent conservation evidence. It explicitly does not constitute B2 or admission evidence.

independent_checks.name: cross_evidence_consistency
independent_checks.finding: PREP01, PREP02, PREP06, B3Q01, GOV03 and SYNQ01 agree on ownership, internal-transfer conservation, Class-A evidence requirements, absence of B2 and the no-admission boundary.

independent_checks.name: residual_uncertainty_explicit
independent_checks.finding: Historical revision-53 behaviour remains unknown because no B2 exists; raw licensed source bytes are not republished in GitHub, so this review rechecks source semantics through exact hash-bound source-audit evidence rather than a fresh raw-byte parse.

allowed: Bapo(Redi,Ly) for active TCD-017 redistribution events

residual_uncertainty: No qualified B2 behavioural reference exists, so historical revision-53 behaviour and historical fidelity remain unknown.

The licensed frozen source archive is hash-pinned but raw Addit.for and Outbal_calc.for bytes are not republished in GitHub; this review independently cross-checks pre-authoring source-bound audits and manifests but does not claim a fresh raw-byte source parse.
Natural activation for the target top-reservoir path is demonstrated in LWKM; inactive natural cases do not enlarge the activation claim.
Separate organic-P defects and candidates, including TCD-027, TCD-028, AdStdiorpopl and Adhuexpopl, remain outside this review.
